shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && cat package.json && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"UsageMetadata|OrchestratorHooks|chatOrchestrator\" src/index.ts src/types src/orchestration/*.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|spec-link' && sed -n '1,180p' src/index.ts && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+|@spec|spec:\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -60 && nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '20,40p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '38,100p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts | sed -n '1,100p' && rg -n \"function accumulateUsage|function createChatOrchestrator|function normalize\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts src/index.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts | sed -n '15,28p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '62,72p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): name total turn usage" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
